row.name: Little Wishes and Big Dreams Playhouse Ltd

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of ten children's immunization records audited were not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Rubber bibs were being washed in the hand sink in the infant room. This was corrected at inspection when the bibs were removed and the director had a discussion with the caregivers on not using the dedicated hand washing sink for washing bottles, toys, bibs, or other items.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver without an eligible background check was present in the classroom with children and another staff.       Note.This was corrected when the staff was asked  to leave and they left the property.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two out of ten staff files did not have the full 24hrs of training at review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: A diaper changing mat was torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: The carbon monoxide detector was not documented as being completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not have documented that they conducted the fire drill for the past month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A caregiver had an infant in a highchair without being strapped in the seat.     *This was corrected at inspection*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: Caregiver did not relate to a child with patience or courtesy with the interaction of making the child cry by grabbing them multiple times leaving a mark.     *Dir terminated the caregiver after reviewing video*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Caregiver grabbed a 4yr old child by the arm leaving a mark on the arm.     *Dir terminated the caregiver after reviewing video*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Based on the information gathered it was determined that one of the staff member's first aid certificate was expired at the time of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The operation had a fire extinguisher in the van, however the fire extinguisher was not secure in the van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver grabbed a 2yr old child by the shoulder and chin hard enough to have the 2yr old off balance.     *Management terminated the caregiver when it was brought to their attention*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children: A 3yr old child had access to the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.4001(5))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: A 3yr old child had access to an aspirin from the first aid kit.     *The child did not swallow the pill. All aspirin were removed from the first aid kits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was unaware that a 3yr old child had acquired an aspirin from a first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know how many children were in her care when asked by CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: An infant child was served food that was an identified allergy.     *The operation has developed a new serving policy that has a picture of the child, what the allergy is, and action to take if exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver left a 3yr old child unattended in the restroom after a restroom break. Same caregiver left a different 3yr child on the indoor playground unattended while returning from that restroom break.     *This caregiver is no longer with the operation. Operation had developed new plan with name to face checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation displayed poor judgement by not notifying the parent that their child was drug across the room by a caregiver to the outdoor playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A 3yr old child was grabbed with their hands over their head by a caregiver and drug across the room to the door leading to the outdoor playground.     *Caregiver is not longer on staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Illness Preventing Care - Child Cannot Participate Comfortably: Based on evidence gathered, staff allowed an ill toddler to remain in care although the child had obvious symptoms of illness over the course of the course of multiple days and was inconsolable, which prevented him from participating in care. The operation did not follow their own written illness policy which stated they would require parent to pick up child if ill and/or if the child is "crying for longer than 1 hour without ability to be consoled."
occurrences.violation_type_title: Illness Preventing Care - Child Cannot Participate Comfortably (26 TAC §746.3601(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on evidence gathered, at least three caregivers who were responsible for a toddler at different times throughout the day, did not share pertinent information with each other regarding marks/bumbs seen on the toddler and incidents the toddler was involved in during their shift with the toddler.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers -Same Caregiver Regularly: Based on evidence gathered, staff did not ensure a toddler was cared for by their regular when they decided to move the toddler to another room with a different caregiver because the toddler's assigned caregiver felt uncomfortable taking care of the toddler when the toddler was sick.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers -Same Caregiver Regularly (26 TAC §746.2501(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: One child did not have a completed special needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A bottle of air freshner was observed on top of the papertowel dispenser making it accessible to children in the pre-k.     Note: This was CORRECTED AT INSPECTION when the air freshner was moved into a cabinet that was out of reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was seen transporting children without an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered in the investigation, a caregiver was yelling at children as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: During the course of this investigation, it was determined that the operation staff did not follow their policy for release of children when a copy of the pick-up persons ID was not saved and placed in the child's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))
